output.summary: KEP-2530 proposes hosting the Alibaba Cloud cloud-controller-manager (an out-of-tree Cloud Provider implementation) as a sig-cloud-provider subproject in a Kubernetes-organization repository. Its status is provisional, dated from 2021-02-22.
output.rationale: The KEP aims to let Kubernetes clusters use Alibaba Cloud infrastructure through an out-of-tree cloud-controller-manager, and to help decouple cloud-specific code from Kubernetes. The proposal is to move the existing open-source project into a Kubernetes-organization repository as a subproject. The sources do not state why the KEP is only provisional rather than accepted.

alternatives.option: Networking support via Flannel for Alibaba Cloud VPC
alternatives.why_not: Excluded from this KEP's scope; the readme says networking and storage support 'will be provided by other projects'.

alternatives.option: Storage support via FlexVolume for Alibaba Cloud
alternatives.why_not: Excluded from this KEP's scope; handled by a separate project per the non-goals.

evidence.quote: Here we propose a repository from Kubernetes organization to host our cloud provider implementation.
Cloud Provider of Alibaba Cloud would be a subproject under Kubernetes community.
The networking and storage support of Alibaba Cloud for Kubernetes will be provided by other projects.
Alibaba Cloud provides the Cloud Provider interface implementation as an out-of-tree cloud-controller-manager.
